title: Career OS Canonical Project Semantic State
description: CAREER_OS_MILESTONE_CONTRACT_AND_STATE_VALIDATION_V1. Small, machine-readable, canonical-MERGED semantic state, checked against BLUEPRINT.md/GitHub reality rather than trusted at face value. Deliberately excludes any current Git SHA (Git/GitHub are always the live source of the current commit) and any transient active-milestone/branch/builder field (active work belongs to a branch-scoped milestone contract, not this canonical-main file).

blueprint_version.description: Must equal BLUEPRINT.md's own 'Final Locked Blueprint vX.Y' header string, checked mechanically, never merely asserted.

latest_locked_section.description: Must equal the highest-numbered '**N. TITLE**' top-level locked section heading actually present in BLUEPRINT.md.

latest_closed_milestone_pr.description: GitHub PR number for the latest closed milestone, or null for a governance record with no PR (e.g. a read-only audit).

next_authorized_action.description: Durable canonical-main authorization state ONLY -- e.g. that no product implementation milestone is currently preselected, or a specific one has been explicitly pre-approved for a future branch. Must remain true after THIS state file's own merge, and must never describe transient in-progress branch work (e.g. never 'MILESTONE_X in progress') or silently pre-authorize a next milestone that has not been separately, explicitly approved. Transient/active-work state belongs exclusively to a branch-scoped milestone contract under milestone_contracts/, never here.
